en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a harbor cityscape with industrial buildings, ships, and wooded hills in the background. The text 'Sundsvall. Hamnen.' is printed in white in the bottom left corner of the photo side. The reverse side features a decorated faded green clover motif, handwritten script, and a purple Swedish postage stamp valued at 10 öre with a lion design and 'SVERIGE' inscription. Some handwriting is partially obscured by design and wear.
